questions.text: What is the shell register map (offset, width, reset value and access of every register)?
questions.default: As in registers.map: 0x00 DESIGN_ID, 0x04 RX_BYTE, 0x08 TICK, 0x0C STATUS, 0x10 REPLY_LEN, 0x14 REPLY_IDX, 0x18 REPLY_WORD, 0x1C TELE_LEN, 0x20 TELE_IDX, 0x24 TELE_WORD, 0x28 TAKE; all 32-bit.
questions.reason: Request names these functions without offsets.
questions.answer:
IN: offset 0x00, WO, reset 0: [7:0] packet byte, [8] end flag
STAT: offset 0x09, RO, reset 0: [0] telemetry on, [1] busy
RIDX: offset 0x03, RW, reset 0: [6:0] word number
RWORD: offset 0x04, RO, reset 0: bytes 4i..4i+3 of the reply, first byte on top, zero past the end
RLEN: offset 0x02, RO, reset 0: length in bytes of the latest reply, 0 if none
TICK: offset 0x01, WO, reset 0: [7:0] n ticks
TIDX: offset 0x06, RW, reset 0: [6:0] word number
TWORD: offset 0x07, RO, reset 0: same for the telemetry frame
TAKE: offset 0x08, WO, reset 0: any write takes the held telemetry frame
TLEN: offset 0x05, RO, reset 0: length of the held telemetry frame, 0 if none
shell: test shell, PROTOCOL.md 1.1
unmapped: no register at an offset: reads 0, writes ignored (read-only registers behave the same on write)
questions.evidence: IN: offset 0x00, WO, reset 0: [7:0] packet byte, [8] end flag

questions.text: Is the status payload 16 or 17 bytes?
questions.default: 17 bytes: seven 16-bit counters plus one 16-bit frame count is 16 bytes, plus the telemetry-on byte is 17.
questions.reason: Request says sixteen bytes and one more.
questions.answer: 17 bytes. The status payload is seven 16-bit counters (14 bytes) plus a 16-bit telemetry frame count (2 bytes) plus a TLM_ON byte (1 byte), which totals 17. The spec lists these fields but does not state the total byte count explicitly.
questions.evidence: STATUS: seven 16-bit counters, telemetry frame count (16 bit), TLM_ON byte, all before this command is counted.

questions.text: What happens if TICK is written while earlier ticks are pending?
questions.default: The new count is added to the pending count, saturating at 65535.
questions.answer: The new count is added to the pending count, saturating at 65535.

questions.text: What width and byte order is the telemetry start period?
questions.default: 16-bit value, high byte first, as the 2-byte payload.
questions.reason: Payload is 2 bytes while the period register is 32-bit.
questions.answer: 16-bit value, high byte first, as the 2-byte payload.

questions.text: Which commands count as carried out?
questions.default: Every packet answered with status 0 counts as carried out.
questions.reason: Request does not define carried out for status, start and stop.
questions.answer: Every packet answered with status 0 counts as carried out.
